test_objective: Check that you can retrieve a context source registration subscription

test_cases.name: 040_01_01 Retrieve Context Source Registration Subscription
test_cases.doc: Check that you can retrieve a context source registration subscription
test_cases.setup: Setup Initial Context Source Registration Subscription
test_cases.teardown: Delete Created Context Source Registration Subscription
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceSubscriptions/{subscription_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Context Source Registration Subscription with data: and
    Query Parameter: subscription id set to '${subscription_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
